description.zh: 停止错误原因。长度为1~4096个字符。
description.en: The reason for stopping the execution. The value must be 1 to 4,096 characters in length.

description.zh: 停止错误代码。长度为1~128个字符。
description.en: The error code for stopping the execution. The error code must be 1 to 128 characters in length.

description.zh: 需要停止的执行名称，可以通过**ListExecutions**的返回值获取。
description.en: The name of the execution to be stopped. You can call the **ListExecutions** operation to obtain the value of this parameter.

description.zh: 需要停止的流程名称，可以通过**ListFlows**的返回值获取。
description.en: The name of the workflow to be stopped. You can call the **ListFlows** operation to obtain the value of this parameter.

title.zh: 停止一个正在执行的流程

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明
流程必须为执行中。
descriptions.en:
## [](#)Usage notes

The flow must be in progress.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun fnf stop-execution --flow-name my_flow_name --execution-name my_exec_name --cause for_test --error InvalidArgument --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun fnf StopExecution --region cn-hangzhou --ExecutionName my_exec_name --FlowName my_flow_name --Cause for_test --Error InvalidArgument
